mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dataset_discovery_candidate ( node_id, file_path, file_name, file_type, size_bytes, checksum, metadata_json, last_modified_at, availability, registered_dataset_id, last_seen_at ) VALUES ( #{nodeId}, #{filePath}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{checksum}, #{metadataJson}, #{lastModifiedAt}, #{availability}, (SELECT r.dataset_id FROM dataset_replica r WHERE r.node_id = #{nodeId} AND r.file_path = #{filePath} LIMIT 1), #{lastSeenAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE file_name = VALUES(file_name), file_type = VALUES(file_type), size_bytes = VALUES(size_bytes), checksum = VALUES(checksum), metadata_json = VALUES(metadata_json), last_modified_at = VALUES(last_modified_at), availability = VALUES(availability), registered_dataset_id = COALESCE(registered_dataset_id, VALUES(registered_dataset_id)), last_seen_at = VALUES(last_seen_at)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dataset_discovery_candidate WHERE node_id = #{nodeId} AND file_path = #{filePath}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO registered_dataset ( legacy_data_id, dataset_code, name, dataset_version, description, data_type, category, data_format, labels_json, required_cpu, required_memory_gi, required_gpu, status, default_runtime_image_id, data_heat, heat_updated_at ) VALUES ( #{legacyDataId}, #{datasetCode}, #{name}, #{datasetVersion}, #{description}, #{dataType}, #{category}, #{dataFormat}, #{labelsJson}, #{requiredCpu}, #{requiredMemoryGi}, #{requiredGpu}, #{status}, #{defaultRuntimeImageId}, COALESCE(#{dataHeat}, 10), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) )
mapper.sql: (#{threshold} + (GREATEST(#{threshold}, COALESCE(data_heat, #{threshold})) - #{threshold}) * EXP(-0.6931471805599453 * GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, COALESCE(heat_updated_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)), 0) / (3600000000.0 * #{halfLifeHours})))
mapper.update: UPDATE registered_dataset SET data_heat = ROUND(, 2), heat_updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = updated_at WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE registered_dataset SET data_heat = ROUND(GREATEST(, #{accessAlpha} * + (1 - #{accessAlpha}) * #{maxHeat}), 2), heat_updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = updated_at WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM registered_dataset WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM registered_dataset WHERE dataset_code = #{datasetCode} AND dataset_version = #{datasetVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE registered_dataset SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, data_type = #{dataType}, category = #{category}, data_format = #{dataFormat}, labels_json = #{labelsJson}, required_cpu = #{requiredCpu}, required_memory_gi = #{requiredMemoryGi}, required_gpu = #{requiredGpu}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND row_version = #{rowVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE registered_dataset SET status = #{status}, verification_message = #{verificationMessage}, verified_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)verified_at, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE registered_dataset SET default_runtime_image_id = #{runtimeImageId}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE registered_dataset SET status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_management WHERE CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(dataset_ids_json) THEN JSON_CONTAINS(dataset_ids_json, CAST(#{datasetId} AS JSON)) ELSE LOCATE(#{datasetName}, selected_data) > 0 END
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scheduling_assignment a JOIN scheduling_plan p ON p.plan_id = a.plan_id WHERE a.dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND p.status IN ('ACCEPTED', 'RUNNING')
SELECT * FROM dataset_replica WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND node_id = #{nodeId} AND file_path = #{filePath}
SELECT * FROM dataset_replica WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} ORDER BY replica_id
mapper.update: UPDATE dataset_replica SET availability = #{availability}, verified_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)verified_at WHERE replica_id = #{replicaId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dataset_replica WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND availability = 'AVAILABLE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dataset_metadata ( dataset_id, metadata_version, digest_algorithm, digest_value, schema_json, profile_json, source_json, scheduling_hints_json, labels_json ) VALUES ( #{datasetId}, #{metadataVersion}, #{digestAlgorithm}, #{digestValue}, #{schemaJson}, #{profileJson}, #{sourceJson}, #{schedulingHintsJson}, #{labelsJson} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE metadata_version = VALUES(metadata_version), digest_algorithm = VALUES(digest_algorithm), digest_value = VALUES(digest_value), schema_json = VALUES(schema_json), profile_json = VALUES(profile_json), source_json = VALUES(source_json), scheduling_hints_json = VALUES(scheduling_hints_json), labels_json = VALUES(labels_json)
